instructions: Does the result text being written to the record faithfully represent what the tool returned, rather than adding interpretation, advice, or claims that were not in the tool output?

options.label: faithful
options.criterion: the text quotes or paraphrases the tool output without adding claims the tool did not make

options.label: adds_claims
options.criterion: the text adds explanations, recommendations, or facts that were not present in the tool output

options.label: cannot_tell
options.criterion: the text is too short or generic to tell whether anything was invented
